item.title: Tell a Friend What Fell Off Your Bike
item.prompt_text: You were walking beside your bike. Its small front basket came off near a white wall. You are waiting on a bench next to that wall. Tell a friend what happened, where you are and what you need your friend to bring.
item.target_grammar: Past simple for the event and present continuous for the place where you are waiting.
item.fluency_objective: Use one sentence about the bike and one about the place. End with a direct request.
item.pronunciation_objective: Stress front basket, white wall and bag. Say white clearly before wall.

cues.text: Give a clear place where you are waiting.
Ask for one thing to be brought.

item.model_opening: The front basket came off my bike.
item.model_answer: The front basket came off my bike. I am waiting on the bench by the white wall. Can you bring a big bag for the things in the basket? Thanks.
